title: Regard, trade and favours
summary: Each camp has a regard for you. Earn its trust and it trades, warns and fights beside you.
text:
Each camp has a **regard** for the colony, from 0 to 100, shown in the Neighbours tab with what's wearing it down.

- Your buildings on their land cost regard each sol; mining their deposits costs more, and a loud Deep-Core Mine most of all
- Clearing nests on their land, good trades and kind answers to their requests earn it back

At high regard they **trust** you: they warn you of packs, share what they see of their land and defend it alongside you. Trusted neighbours (or ones you can speak with, after the research Translation Matrix) **trade**, and you can ask them for **favours**: guides, lookouts, or hunters to help with a pack. Each favour costs a little regard.

Let regard fall too far and they grow uneasy, may raid an outlying holding, and at worst abandon their camp.
